rules.range_momentum: at range 4-8 (no camp hit, not capturing): closes iff its previous step continued would close
rules.forced_route: route forces a closing step (hindsight goal): progresses iff hp/maxhp > 0.5
rules.danger_steps: among route-progress steps with different danger, takes a minimum-danger step (vs random share)
rules.camp_continue: at a camp with an enemy in sight: keeps hitting iff the nearest enemy is beyond 4 (alt: iff no enemy D reaches its tile)
rules.early_mode: early level written only when some side has positive one-turn damage at the end tile (end distance 3-5)
rules.retreat: not-adjacent contact: walking retreat iff hp/maxhp <= 0.36 and side EHP ratio <= 1.3
rules.retreat_direction: retreats shorten the home walk (vs straight-away placebo); ends: reengage/home/farm
rules.lost_sight: no pursuit: a lost target's last-seen tile is opened on more than closed on
rules.hunt: no hunting: closing on remembered enemies >= 9 away equals the mirror placebo
rules.after_kill: fights on iff another enemy is in sight
rules.convergence: blind allies do not converge on an unseen fight beyond the quiet control

seventh_commands: PYTHONPATH=tools/fish python3 tools/fish/engage_eval.py research/fish-2026-11-05/engage-results-seventh.json --held seventh --range replays/fish-engage/range-v1.jsonl.gz replays/fish-engage/range-seventh-v1.jsonl.gz --retreat replays/fish-engage/retreat-v2.jsonl.gz replays/fish-engage/retreat-seventh-v2.jsonl.gz --team-cache replays/fish-engage/team-seventh
